description: List recent evidence receipts for a monitor.

api_key.description: Buyer-owned FluxProof API key. Treat as a secret: do not include in transcripts, public logs or support messages.

limit.description: Maximum recent receipts requested; defaults to 20. History access is restricted by the key’s plan.

monitor_id.description: Exact monitor_id returned when this key created the monitor; another account cannot access it.

name: fluxproof_list_changes
